verses.1:
Praise the LORD, all you nations!
 Extol Him, all you peoples! + 117:1 Cited in Romans 15:11|ROM 15:11
verses.2:
For great is His loving devotion toward us,
 and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.
 Hallelujah! + 117:2 Or Hallelu YAH , meaning Praise the LORD
